inputs.name: workgroup
inputs.description: Workgroup or NetBIOS domain name the server shows in. WORKGROUP is what Windows uses out of the box.

inputs.name: server_string
inputs.description: Description the server gives clients. Samba expands %h to the host name and %v to its version.

inputs.name: min_protocol
inputs.description: Oldest SMB dialect the server accepts. SMB1 stays off at any setting here.

inputs.name: netbios
inputs.description: Run nmbd and listen on port 139, so older clients can find the server by NetBIOS name. Off, the server answers on 445 only.

inputs.name: shares
inputs.type:
map(object({
    path           = string
    comment        = optional(string)
    writable       = optional(bool, false)
    browseable     = optional(bool, true)
    guest_ok       = optional(bool, false)
    valid_users    = optional(list(string), [])
    create_mask    = optional(string, "0664")
    directory_mask = optional(string, "0775")
    owner          = optional(string)
    group          = optional(string)
    mode           = optional(string, "0755")
  }))
inputs.description: Shares, by name, such as { media = { path = "/srv/media", writable = true, valid_users = ["alice"] } }. The circuit creates each path with owner, group and mode.

inputs.name: users
inputs.description: Samba users, each with a password in user_passwords. A user needs a Unix account of the same name; the circuit creates one with no login shell when it's missing.

inputs.name: user_passwords
inputs.description: Password for each of users, by name. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_user_passwords; it never reaches state or the plan.
